newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels air cargo traffic up 5.1 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Brussels air cargo traffic up 5.1 pct in 1996.

text.p: Brussels airport handled 464,277 tonnes of cargo including mail in 1996, a rise of 5.1 pct over the previous year, an airport statement said.
The figures show a sharp increase in express traffic, up 21.5 percent at 222,0000 tonnes, accounting for 49.3 percent of total freight tonnage last year, it added.
Excluding mail and express traffic, other freight declined to 229,000 tonnes.
Mail traffic fell by 9.4 percent to 13,277 tonnes,
DHL Worldwide Express is a major user of the airport.

Cargo traffic for 8.6 percent of traffic movements in 1996 compared with 8.4 pct the previous year. Scheduled passenger traffic represented 76.2 percent (75.3 percent) of movements and charters 6.7 percent (6.9 percent). --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax+44-171-542-5017.
